lesson_title: Longitudinal System Identification from Skywalker X8 UAV Flight Tests
classification_rule: MIT measured rasters remain contextual source artifacts from a different vehicle. A Skywalker X8 plot computed from Version 1.0 CC0 numeric observations is a rights-cleared recomputation only when deterministic data and code reproduce it. Protocol and pipeline diagrams are house explanatory drawings. No sourced, synthetic, or schematic graphic may be described as a computed X8 result.

visuals.teaching_claim: MIT's published perching-glider scatter motivates why a fitted physical model needs validation; it is not Skywalker X8 evidence.
visuals.license: MIT OCW CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; no separate third-party restriction is marked on the slide
truth_guardrails: State that the raster depicts a different perching glider, not the Skywalker X8.
Embed the sourced raster; do not redraw, digitize, smooth, or fit its point clouds.
Do not transfer a flat-plate baseline, high-angle regime, stall label, or numeric comparison into the X8 study.
Retain the exact MIT OCW attribution and CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 conditions.

visuals.teaching_claim: MIT's recorded perching sequence motivates why an aircraft model should face untouched flight records; it is not an X8 validation maneuver.
visuals.license: MIT OCW CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; no separate third-party restriction is marked on the slide
truth_guardrails: State that the image depicts a different vehicle and campaign.
Do not extract pixel coordinates, timing, speed, input, or response samples.
Preserve the native observed sequence; do not sharpen or invent aircraft positions.

visuals.teaching_claim: Creator-designated maneuver-level separation keeps all seven longitudinal training records out of both untouched longitudinal validation records.
visuals.license: house-authored explanatory component; no external image credit required
required_content: seven independent longitudinal training records and two independent validation records
visible record boundaries and lag-state reset at every file
all preprocessing, delay/order selection, and fitting confined to training
a rejected random-row shuffle and no final-percentage holdout claim
truth_guardrails: Use abstract blocks, not invented flight traces or scores.
Caption as protocol; do not call the split a computed result.

visuals.teaching_claim: The frozen ARX(2,1,1) is predictively better than matched-order input-free AR(2) on both X8 validation maneuvers in both prediction modes, while structured one-step residual autocorrelation leaves it incomplete.
visuals.license: Underlying Version 1.0 observations are CC0-1.0; the course figure is a derived recomputation whose provenance must include DOI, version, file checksums, and code/output checksums.
required_provenance_fields: dataset title, creators, DOI 10.18710/U4TLYV, Version 1.0, CC0-1.0, and retrieval date
the nine original datafile IDs, paths, and MD5 checksums
README column names, units, 40 Hz convention, synchronization caveat, missing-value rule, and independent file boundaries
seven creator-designated training and two creator-designated validation records
baseline and low-order AR/ARX equations plus deterministic training-only preprocessing, lag, delay, order, and fitting procedure
separate one-step and free-run metrics for each validation maneuver and an explicitly defined aggregate
script path and script/protocol/output checksums from results/build-manifest.json
truth_guardrails: Use only values reproduced in results/validation-summary.json; equal-maneuver macro NRMSE improvement is 12.0% one-step and 60.3% free-run, with no minimum threshold promised.
Do not use the MIT raster or either former synthetic benchmark as numeric data.
Do not label either validation maneuver a stall region or call EstimatedState_alpha a stall flag.
Show both validation maneuvers, both prediction modes where metrics are summarized, and the structured-residual adequacy limitation.

visuals.teaching_claim: The Skywalker X8 study maps a physical fixed-wing UAV through manually synchronized 40 Hz records and training-only model selection to frozen per-maneuver validation.
visuals.license: house-authored explanatory component; no external image credit required
required_content: manually synchronized/resampled 40 Hz record with elevator and pitch-rate units
training-only preprocessing, effective-delay/order selection, and coefficient fitting
frozen one-step and free-run prediction on two creator-designated validation maneuvers
a hard boundary preventing validation samples from feeding any modeling choice
truth_guardrails: Use generic vehicle and record symbols, not measured traces.
Show manual synchronization as a limitation on exact physical-delay inference.
Do not show numeric performance or a successful validation outcome until B1 clears.

publication_conditions: For visuals 1 and 2, retain MIT OCW attribution and CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 terms and state visibly that the vehicle differs from the Skywalker X8.
Do not digitize either MIT raster or compare it numerically with the X8 records.
For visuals 3 and 5, revise labels to the creator-designated maneuver partition and Skywalker X8 pipeline without adding measured-looking traces.
For visual 4, preserve DOI/version/file checksums and the script/protocol/artifact-set hashes; render only the verified derived prediction and summary artifacts.
